note: Pre-registered before any challenge code or G sim run. The challenge tolerances are the 2016-2023 actuals' intervals: the range of the eight regular-season values (data/game/challenges.json, actuals). The other checks are the spec's G7 proposals as written, confirmed by the lead. Never changed after the first G run. Only Joseph adds known_deviations.
comparison: In-sample run (scripts/game/calibrate.ts --target insample, 10 leagues x 1,000 games), AI on both sides, challenges on vs off, same seeds; the challenge metrics against the 2016-2023 actuals.

perTeamGame.definition: Coach's challenges of the five modeled close-call kinds per team-game.
perTeamGame.rule: the simulated value lies within the interval

reversalShare.definition: Share of those coach's challenges reversed.
reversalShare.rule: the simulated value lies within the interval

againstNoChallengeRun.note: Every scrimmage class share (each class of the run and pass families, over all snaps that reach a class draw, by the class as finally ruled) within 0.2 percentage points of the no-challenge run; points per team-game mean within 0.3 points; turnovers per team-game within 0.05; no in-sample gated step 5 metric goes from pass to fail.
